text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Malta Employers' Association will focus on the ideal relationship between labour costs, competitiveness and social cohesion at its annual conference later this month.
- METCO, a state-owned export corporation, launches Export Market Research Scheme to draw up reports on particular markets seen as ideal for Maltese exports.
- Five five-star hotels under construction, an investment of Lm75 million ($210 million).

- Search continues for remains of Piper Lance, five-seater aircraft which crashed on flight from Tunisia to Malta in December killing all on board. Some remains were found last month close to Tunisia.
- Government seeking new areas to build units for social housing.
